patch_description: A completely different approach: instead of a single deterministic greedy pass, use a randomized multi-start strategy. We generate many candidate initial placements via randomized greedy (model order shuffled, tie-breaking randomized) with a "best-fit KVPR" rule, then apply a compact move-based local search (relocate only, computed with O(1) incremental KVPR evaluation) to each candidate, keeping the best result. Models are tracked by index internally to avoid object-identity bugs (the prior failure, "list.remove(x): x not in list", was caused by duplicate/equal model objects). Fixed RNG seed ensures determinism. The multi-start randomized approach escapes bad greedy orderings and reliably lowers max KVPR compared to a single greedy pass.
